items.title: Land the red reproduction as a registered test that fails on the current defect
items.context: A working reproduction already exists and has been run: it imports eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade from core/review-escalation.js and evaluateHostVerdictRounds from core/host-independence.js, builds two quorum submissions (3 rounds x 2 hosts) at different materialDigests sharing one storyFilesHash, and asserts the correct behaviour of 3/3 valid rounds with no manufactured duplicate-identity reasons. It also asserts non-vacuity (the current-material submission alone must already yield 3/3) and that all verdicts are distinct on disk. Land it under packages/main/tests/red/ following the existing red-b2aa7-*.mjs convention and register it in lattice.config.json validate.commands.
items.userSees: The registered red test fails before the fix with 'DOWNGRADE COLLISION: ... counted as 0/3 valid rounds' and passes after it

happy.desc: The registered red test exits 0 once the fix lands, printing the OK line

edge.desc: Before the fix the same test exits 1 with the 0/3 collision message, proving it is genuinely red

adversarial.desc: The test refuses to pass vacuously: if the current-material quorum alone did not already yield 3/3 it reports FIXTURE IS VACUOUS, and if the fixture verdicts were not distinct on disk it reports FIXTURE ERROR

items.title: Skip the downgrade rewrite when it would collide with a live verdict of the same identity
items.context: In eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade (core/review-escalation.ts), a verdict from an older materialDigest is rewritten to the current one whenever storyFilesHash matches. Add a precondition: do not rewrite when a verdict with the same runId and the same independent host identity (hostId/sessionId/keyId, matching how groupByIndependentHost in core/host-independence.ts compares them) already exists natively at the current materialDigest. Keep emitting the re-attestation advisory for genuinely downgraded verdicts so the existing behaviour for unrelated drift is unchanged.
items.userSees: review_escalation_status reports the floor satisfied with 3/3 rounds x 2 hosts when a complete quorum exists at the current material, even though a superseded quorum shares its storyFilesHash
